title: Remove duplicates without reordering
prompt: Return each distinct integer once, keeping the order of its first appearance. Do not change the input. Use a set to track seen values and a vector to retain order.

tests.label: Empty
tests.hint: Empty input produces an empty result.

tests.label: One repeated value
tests.hint: Append only when insert reports a new value.

tests.label: Signs and zero
tests.hint: Track the actual integer value, including its sign.

hints: unordered_set::insert returns a pair. Its second member says whether insertion was new.
The set handles membership; the vector handles order.
explanation: One container answers “have I seen it?” and another records the required sequence. Iterating the unordered_set itself would lose the specified order.
